brief.t: START HERE: Call Aaron and Evelyn, with Sam looped in, to verify Silk Factor’s location and authorized release status.

ACT NOW 1: Silk Factor — release discrepancy is 2 days old. The 26 kg waiver awaits microbial results and lacks Luke’s acceptance, but contains conflicting release language and dates. Shipment and authorized disposition remain unverified. Send internally: Aaron and Evelyn, please confirm both lots’ locations and any shipments, reconcile Luke’s acceptance, microbial results and waiver dates with Sam today, and document disposition before further release.

ACT NOW 2: Talova — incident reported 12 days ago. Safe-method approval, trial evidence and suspect-unit disposition remain unverified; no new clearance found in the bounded review. Send internally: Sam, Ron and Aaron, please record the safety approver, recovery method, trial evidence and suspect-unit disposition today before affected-method reuse or a completion promise.

ACT NOW 3: Roon — November 17 trial is 2 days away. Tuesday’s 3 PM customer recap still needs accepted scope, released materials, capper readiness and approved cleaning. Six new Lotioncrafter COAs are documents, not receiving or QC release; Acticire is scheduled to ship November 19. Send internally: Michael, Evelyn and Aaron, please reconcile Tuesday’s trial materials and lots, capper readiness and approved cleaning today, then confirm an achievable scope before accepting the date.
